verdict.rationale: Keycloak's docs say social login is added through the admin console by selecting the network, with no code or application changes required. External OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0 identity providers are likewise brokered purely through configuration, and users can link multiple providers to one account. A long-term community user independently reports integrating many external IdPs for SSO. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported social providers to substantiate the 'broad set' claim, and in-depth per-provider configuration documentation.
